allow_instructions: Read-only inspection of source files and git history for code review context.
block_instructions: Block any command that writes, modifies, deletes, or commits files.
Block git push, git commit, npm publish, curl, wget, and package installs.
Block reads of .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa, and credential files.
Block rm, mv, cp, chmod, tee, sed -i, and patch operations.
Block node scripts/ invocations — PR operations use custom tools only.
Block npm test, pnpm test, yarn test, make test, and cargo test.
Block npm run lint, pnpm lint, yarn lint, and other lint/format/build script invocations.
